description: This PHP class defines an admin controller for managing a DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) fraud extension within the OpenCart platform. It includes methods for displaying a configuration page, saving settings, installation, uninstallation, and reporting IP addresses involved in DDoS activity.

classes.name: Ddos
classes.description: Admin controller class for managing DDoS-related fraud extensions in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the DDoS management page with breadcrumbs, configuration options, and page layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration data for the DDoS extension, including permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation logic for the DDoS extension, invoking the model method to set up needed data.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for the DDoS extension, invoking the model method to clean up.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates a report of IP addresses involved in DDoS attempts, with pagination and links to detailed customer info.
